line.text: I heard you. Can I call you back?
You wanted to change the subject. Look at us, negotiating.
I do the talking. You do the chairs.
And the rent. And the electricity. And explaining why a bride is shouting at a woman she met eight minutes ago.
Ten minutes. Twenty dollars. Half each.
No telling people what anyone said.
And what are we actually selling?
I'm good. I'm not that good.
No happy endings. Put it on speaker.

notes: Shortened inserts, privacy reaction and ending holds; no dialogue or speech content changed.
Thirty motivated cuts now vary from 1.25 to 3 seconds; target is 65 seconds, not padded to 90.
Nora’s You wanted half is heard over Leah’s reaction; Fine is heard over the receipt insert. Both are explicitly off screen.
Long dialogue still spans reactions; native five-second audio-window segmentation and one-visible-line support need work before coverage.
Applied as resumable guarded individual service calls, not an atomic all-at-once cut transaction.

timing.limits: Snapshot of saved placement and durations measured when speech was registered. Missing/rejected files are unmeasured; later implicit starts stay unknown after unmeasured speech.
